newsitem.title: USA: StorageTek reports on share buy program.
newsitem.headline: StorageTek reports on share buy program.

text.p: Storage Technology Corp, in reporting higher than expected third quarter earnings on Tuesday, said revenue from mainframe DASD (direct access storage device) business "increased substantially" year-over year and over the second quarter of 1996.

The company earned $.65 a share, against a year-earlier loss of $0.19 a share. Analysts had expected the company to earn $0.59 a share, according to First Call estimates. The range of estimates stood at $0.55 to $0.64.
The Louisville, Colorado-based company also said sales of its flagship Nearline tape automation business rose 12 percent over the year-earlier period.
The third quarter represented the first full quarter of operations under an OEM (original equipment manufacture) agreement for mainframe DASD business with International Business Machines Corp.
The company also said it bought 4.5 million shares of its common stock and retired the shares leaving 56.8 million outstanding as of Sept 27.
